integrity: The full primary text was inspected at the construction, Theorem 1.1, Theorem 1.2, the conformal identity, and the exact Laplacian computation. The new argument keeps the source's quadratic conformal correction but frees its coefficient, proves strict concavity of the resulting pointwise certificate, solves the two endpoint inequalities exactly, and optimizes the resulting uniform bound. A symbolic checker independently verifies all algebraic identities and series coefficients.
scientific_limitations: The parameter interval is exact for the explicit lower-bound certificate obtained from the published curvature estimate and conformal identity, not for the unknown true positivity region of the metrics. The optimizer maximizes that certified uniform lower bound only. The theorem is restricted to 0<epsilon<=1/4 and positive conformal coefficient.
title: Exact certificate window for the Chen--Zhang conformal correction
